title: Reconquering Bell sampling on qudits: stabilizer learning and testing, quantum pseudorandomness bounds, and more
abstract: arXiv:2510.06848v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bell sampling is a simple yet powerful tool based on measuring two copies of a quantum state in the Bell basis, and has found applications in a plethora of problems related to stabiliser states and measures of magic. However, it was not known how to generalise the procedure from qubits to $d$-level systems -- qudits -- for all dimensions $d > 2$ in a useful way. Indeed, a prior work of the authors (arXiv'24) showed that the natural extension of Bell sampling to arbitrary dimensions fails to provide meaningful information about the quantum states being measured. In this paper, we overcome the difficulties encountered in previous works and develop a useful generalisation of Bell sampling to qudits of all $d\geq 2$. At the heart of our primitive is a new unitary, based on Lagrange's four-square theorem, that maps four copies of any stabiliser state $|\mathcal{S}\rangle$ to four copies of its complex conjugate $|\mathcal{S}^\ast\ra

translated_title: 重新征服量子比特上的贝尔采样：稳定子学习与测试、量子伪随机性界及更多
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.06848v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：贝尔采样是一种简单而强大的工具，基于在贝尔基下测量量子态的两个副本，并在与稳定子态和魔力度量相关的众多问题中找到了应用。然而，对于所有维度 $d > 2$ 的 $d$ 级系统——即量子比特——如何以有用的方式推广该过程此前未知。实际上，作者先前的工作（arXiv'24）表明，贝尔采样到任意维度的自然扩展无法提供关于被测量量子态的有意义信息。在本文中，我们克服了先前工作中遇到的困难，并开发了一种对所有 $d\geq 2$ 的量子比特有用的贝尔采样推广。我们原始方法的核心是一个基于拉格朗日四平方定理的新酉变换，它将任何稳定子态 $|\mathcal{S}\rangle$ 的四个副本映射到其复共轭 $|\mathcal{S}^\ast\rangle$ 的四个副本。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于拉格朗日四平方定理的新酉变换，成功将贝尔采样从量子比特推广到所有维度的量子比特系统，解决了此前任意维度推广失败的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel unitary based on Lagrange's four-square theorem, successfully generalizing Bell sampling from qubits to qudits of all dimensions, overcoming the previous failure of naive extensions.
